quotes.text: The Thunderbird review guidance calls for checking whether older asynchronous work can finish after replacement, whether cancellation starts in time, whether every close path cleans up, and whether partial content has an accessible loading state. Apply these checks when a patch changes asynchronous UI behavior. The guidance alone does not show that D325951 has such a defect.
